sections.headline: Paint that holds up to Houston humidity
sections.subheadline: Interior and exterior painting in Katy, Memorial and the Heights. Mildew-resistant primers, clean lines, written quote in 48 hours.

sections.title: What we paint
sections.intro: Homes, townhouses and small shops across West Houston.

items.name: Exterior painting
items.description: Pressure washed, scraped, primed against mildew and finished in two coats.

items.name: Interior painting
items.description: Walls, ceilings and trim, with furniture moved and floors covered.

items.name: Cabinet refinishing
items.description: Kitchen cabinets degreased, sanded and sprayed.

items.name: Fence and deck staining
items.description: Cleaned and sealed to slow sun and rain damage.

sections.title: How a job goes
sections.body: We walk the house with you, send a written quote within two days and agree a start date. Every evening the site is swept and the furniture goes back where it was.

items.author: Dana Whitfield
items.text: Two summers on and the exterior still looks fresh. No peeling at all.

items.author: Luis Ortega
items.text: On time every day and they cleaned up better than we do.

items.author: Hannah Cole
items.text: Our cabinets look brand new and the quote was exactly what we paid.

items.author: Marcus Bell
items.text: Clear quote, no surprises, great lines on the trim.

sections.headline: Tell us about the house
sections.body: Call or email and we'll come look, then send a written quote within 48 hours.
